paragraphs: Sentrycs makes counter-drone systems that detect, track, identify and mitigate unauthorized drones for defense, homeland security and critical infrastructure environments. Rather than radar, it uses passive RF cyber technology to pick up drone communication signals and locate both the drone and its operator. Detection reports the drone type, serial number and operator position. Mitigation does not jam the drone; the system takes control of it through a cyber takeover. If required, it integrates with other types of effector, including jammers.

The company says a team of communications and radio frequency experts embarked in 2017 on developing modular solutions that could be tailored to each customer's drone environment. The system is built for complex and urban environments, where it aims to minimize interference with surrounding communications. It says its customers include governments, security forces and critical infrastructure operators worldwide. Its blog is aimed partly at law enforcement, with posts on how to legally take down a rogue drone and on lessons from recent UAS attacks.

On November 18th, 2025, Ondas Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:ONDS) announced it had completed the acquisition of Sentrycs. The announcement describes the company as Sentry CS Ltd., based in Israel. It puts Sentrycs at approximately 200 deployments across six continents in more than 25 countries.

quote.text: Sentrycs closes the operational loop with its autonomous counter-drone solutions.
